what: hir-ty infer.rs collect_fn (~2828-2854) requires Sized of self, the parameters and the return type for a trait method with no body (`fn into_iter(self) -> FooIter;`, `fn unused_method(&self) -> Self;`). rustc runs check_fn only for a body, so these are false SolverDiagnostics (SizedArgumentType / SizedReturnType, TraitUnimplemented Sized) with no syntax of their own, and blaze-diagnostics prints them as `blaze: type checking's SolverDiagnostic(..) ... which blaze cannot place`. Tests: tests::lints::bodies::calls::desugar::array_into_iter_ambiguous, tests::lints::bodies::calls::items::atomic_ordering_false_positive, tests::lints::names::dead::unused_adt_impls_pub_trait. Skip the Sized requirements (or the inference) when the function has no body.

history.note: Already in the tree: hir-ty infer.rs collect_fn asks Sized of the self param, the params and the return type only when FunctionSignature::has_body (params_sized / has_body). No edit.
